title: Dictionary Entries
description: Look at the dictionary entries below. Use the information provided to complete the sentences.

entries.definition: the characteristics, feelings or beliefs that distinguish people from others
bullet_points: Rapid modernisation can lead to a tragic [loss of identity] in historic rural communities.
The author explored the [sense of personal identity] among teenage refugees.
Traditional songs help immigrants [preserve cultural identity] while living in foreign lands.
Passports serve as official [identity documents] during international airport security checks.

questions.text: Generations of craftspeople believe that passing down ancient pottery skills helps their community __________ despite rapid globalisation.
Before boarding the ferry to the island, each passenger's __________ were inspected by customs officials.

entries.definition: an accepted way of behaving or of doing things in a society or a community
bullet_points: Nomadic elders prefer to [live by custom] rather than modern urban regulations.
It is considered a [matter of local custom] to remove your footwear before entering.
Villagers gather every spring to [observe the custom] of blessing the harvest.
Bowing deeply upon greeting guests is an [ancient custom] in East Asian societies.

questions.text: Sharing hot herbal tea with weary travelers arriving at the temple gate is an __________ that dates back to the twelfth century.
Presenting gifts with both hands during the welcoming ceremony is treated as a __________ by all community leaders.

entries.definition: a style of cooking, especially of a particular country or establishment
bullet_points: Talented pastry chefs must master advanced [cuisine techniques] before opening a bakery.
Travelers often [sample local cuisine] at bustling night markets.
The international food festival featured authentic [regional cuisine] from five different provinces.
Culinary students spend months learning to [cook vegetarian cuisine] using organic produce.

questions.text: During their homestay tour through the northern valleys, tourists had a wonderful chance to __________ freshly prepared over open hearths.
Distinct __________ reflects the unique microclimate, agricultural heritage, and coastal geography of each seaside district.

entries.definition: to happen or appear for the first time in a particular place or situation
bullet_points: Many world-famous carnivals [originate as religious] observances before transforming into public street parades.
These traditional herbal remedies [originate from ancient] medicinal manuscripts.
The festive celebration may [originate with nomadic tribes] who traveled across the central plains.
Several classical melodies [originate in rural] villages along the river valley.

questions.text: Ethnomusicologists discovered that these vibrant wedding flutes __________ mountainous communities far from the royal capital.
The restorative properties of this herbal tea __________ botanical compendiums compiled by monastic scholars.

entries.definition: to recognize the good qualities or value of somebody or something
bullet_points: Museum docents [fully appreciate] the historical significance of these bronze artifacts.
Tourists pause along the scenic terrace to [appreciate the beauty of] ancient terraced rice paddies.
Visitors learn to [appreciate cultural nuances] when observing traditional ceremonies.
Educators encourage students to [appreciate the value of] preserving folklore songs.

questions.text: Historians argue that modern observers can only __________ the depth of this temple architecture by examining its stone foundations.
Living abroad for several years helps diplomats __________ that cannot be learned from textbooks alone.
